Each need has exactly id, parent, discovered_from, target_or_event, relation, time_version_scope, evidence_sought, support_requirements, defeat_requirements, alternatives, and unresolved_conditions. Do not include question or rationale fields; the target, relation and scope state the obligation compactly. Use stable unique nonempty IDs, null for an absent parent or scalar scope field, and empty arrays only when a list field does not apply. Keep support and defeat requirements, alternatives, and unresolved conditions explicit. Specify a target_or_event or relation. At least one of evidence_sought, support_requirements, or defeat_requirements must be nonempty. Each list contains distinct nonempty strings, except discovered_from, which contains distinct verified read IDs. The host retains this immutable registry and shows it in need_registry on later turns; for an undated current revision, record the scope as the current pinned source revision. planning_phase is declare, act_after_plan, or investigate. After the initial plan, return exactly {"state":text,"need_additions":[need,...],"tool":tool}. need_additions contains only brand-new needs (or is empty); never repeat or edit registered needs. A new need may name an earlier need as parent and may cite only verified read IDs in discovered_from. Every action after planning must include a non-null task-relevant tool linked by need_id to a registered need. Tool requests include need_id and use these field shapes: {"op":"search","need_id":<registered-id>,"query":<text>}; {"op":"read","need_id":<registered-id>,"candidate":<integer-or-integer-list>}; when probes are enabled, {"op":"probe","need_id":<registered-id>,"read":<integer>,"ordinal":<integer>,"outcomes":[<text>,...],"hops":<integer-optional>}. A read list batches candidates only when the host enables it. The first action after planning must search. Do not plan again or send a no-op state update. Formulate task-relevant search queries and read only candidates returned in this episode for that need, and use reason/role_spans when enabled. Zero search matches are not proof of absence. A final object is exactly {"finish":{"findings":list,"open_questions":list}}. Findings have exactly need_id, claim, stance (supports, defeats, unknown, conflicted, or hypothetical), citations, and reason, with optional role_support for an actual joint result. Every registered need needs a finding. citations is an array of verified read IDs, empty only for hypothetical or unknown findings. Every unknown needs a same-need open question naming the unresolved premise. Open questions have exactly need_id and question. Cite the joint seed, premises, terminal and authority reads when using role_support. Do not turn missing, ambiguous, stale or exhausted evidence into a settled answer. Pass a list of candidate numbers to read to open those candidates together. Every candidate in a read list counts against the read allowance.
